frozenBy: T264A (owner-approved issue #264 correction; planning review A/B FAIL)
purpose: Pre-declare the numeric runtime signals, thresholds, hysteresis, pass bounds, render strategy, independence rule, holdout split, and acceptance thresholds for a later adaptive second-analysis pass, before any of it is implemented or measured. No value below may be changed after a scored run; a change requires a new version and a separately reported run.

prerequisites.description: geometry_detector.dart is owned by T086B until that task merges. T264 must not edit it concurrently.
prerequisites.evidence: xxammaxx/t086b has no commits beyond the task-doc merge at the T264 start; the T264 baseline reads the detector read-only.

prerequisites.description: Pass/observation provenance decision. A cross-pass observation needs an explicit detector-pass identity; SuggestionSchema v1 and recognition-output §6 only dedup exact duplicates within one pass (same type, same detectorPass, IoU > 0.98), so cross-pass near-duplicates would currently surface as conflicts.
requiredChange: SuggestionSchema schemaVersion bump decision (v1 -> v2) with a documented migration
T058 persistence migration for the bumped schema

A cross-pass merge rule: same-pass exact-duplicate collapse stays IoU > 0.98; cross-pass observations require an explicit detectorPass provenance field and a declared spatial merge rule before any adaptive pass writes into a suggestion set

prerequisites.description: Structure comparison needs a declared ground truth, so it is an evaluation signal, not a runtime trigger. Runtime triggers must use only measurable page/pipeline state.
prerequisites.decision: Runtime triggers are limited to photometric quality, caller-supplied skew, OCR failure/emptiness, unlabelled-field fraction, and conflict-graph pair count. Structure comparison stays evaluation-only (benchmark and evidence), never a production trigger.

independence.rule: Every adaptive variant derives from the same original page scan and is correlated evidence.
independence.note: An adaptive pass must never set twoIndependentOcrLinesAgree, must never raise the independent-OCR confidence bonus, and must report its provenance as correlated.

runtimeSignals.measuredOn: photometric original (full luminance histogram), never on a binarised derivative

skew.metric: caller-supplied absolute skew in degrees (never estimated by the policy)

ocrFailure.metric: OCR port threw, or produced zero usable label lines

missingLabel.metric: unlabelled field candidates / all field candidates

bounds.pageFailureIsolation: A failed adaptive pass returns the pass-1 result unchanged and never removes page geometry.

renderStrategy.decision: v1 uses same-DPI photometric variants plus deskew only.
allowed: contrastStretch: linear stretch from the measured 5th/95th percentiles to 0/255 on the same raster grid
deskew: nearest-neighbour rotation at the caller-supplied angle on the same page extent
excluded: higher-resolution crop in v1: the analysis contract is fixed at 200 DPI with an exact RasterSize, the port has no RasterRequest crop, and the documented 4096 px cap silently downscales, so a 2x crop would either change the analysis scale or silently lose resolution
renderStrategy.futureOption: A region render or scale-aware analysis path needs its own contract change and a measured pixel-identity proof before any 2x claim.
renderStrategy.memoryCeiling: A variant raster may not exceed 8000000 pixels (one variant at a time). A4 portrait at 200 DPI is 1654 x 2339 = 3,868,706 px, so exactly one full-page variant fits.

requiredOutcomes: mean matched IoU(C) >= mean matched IoU(A)
false accepts: zero extra or type-mismatched proposals may be auto-confirmed; nothing is auto-confirmed, so the reported false-accept count must be 0
acceptanceThresholds.noGainClaim: If no mode C outcome is strictly better than mode A, the conservative baseline stays and the report must say so. No existing SC gate is lowered by this policy.

corpusAndHoldout.rule: Thresholds and variants may be developed on devPages only. holdoutPages are scored once at the end; a holdout-driven change requires a new policy version and a new scored run.
corpusAndHoldout.realForms: No rights-cleared real authority form is part of this corpus. Real-form and Android EMULATOR evidence remain NOT_RUN until a rights-cleared holdout exists.
